Tê Bar is one of Da Nang’s best-kept secrets
Mar 2025 • Couples
Tê Bar is one of Da Nang’s best-kept secrets—hidden on the third floor above Cộng Cà Phê on Nguyễn Thái Học Street. The entrance is unmarked and mysterious, adding to the charm of this dark, speakeasy-style cocktail bar. Once inside, you're welcomed by a moody, intimate setting with low lighting, eclectic décor, and a cool, laid-back vibe.

The cocktail menu is inventive and well-executed, with standout drinks like the pho-inspired cocktail that creatively blends Vietnamese herbs and spices. The bartenders are skilled and friendly, always ready with a great recommendation based on your taste.

Perfect for a quiet evening or a unique date night, Tê Bar offers a more refined nightlife experience away from the usual tourist spots. Highly recommended for cocktail lovers looking for something special in Da Nang.
